headline: Sterling is holding just above $1.32, near a three-month low, ahead of US core inflation (PCE) at 16:30 Dubai today. The dollar is on course for a gain of about 2% in September. UK growth for the second quarter was revised up to 0.5%.

drivers.title: US inflation today
drivers.text: August core PCE, the Fed's preferred inflation measure, is due at 16:30 Dubai. Forecasts are 0.3% on the month, up from 0.2% in July, and 3.3% to 3.4% on the year. US private payrolls (ADP) come out at 16:15 Dubai.

drivers.title: Fed pricing
drivers.text: The Fed raised its range to 3.75% to 4.00% on 16 September. Estimates of the chance of another rise on 28 October range from about half to about 70%. They fell on Tuesday after the New York Fed's John Williams said he saw no urgency.

drivers.title: The dollar
drivers.text: The dollar index was about 101.4 on Wednesday morning. It is set for a gain of about 2% in September.

drivers.title: The UK side
drivers.text: The ONS revised second quarter growth up to 0.5% from 0.4%, and business investment rose 1.8% in the quarter. Markets put more than an 80% chance on a Bank of England rise in November. Bank Rate is 3.75%, and 10-year gilt yields are about 5.35%, near 19-year highs.

drivers.title: Oil and the Gulf
drivers.text: Brent rose about 1% to $103.73 a barrel early on Wednesday, after President Trump denied a report that he would ease sanctions on Iran. Qatar says it is passing messages between Iran and the US. Brent is heading for a gain of about 14% in September.

drivers.title: Where sterling stands
drivers.text: GBP/USD was about 1.3224 to 1.3268 on Wednesday, down about 2.4% over the month. Its low for 2026 is 1.3140, set in June.

lower: Core PCE today, or Friday's payrolls, coming in above forecast, which would revive bets on an October Fed rise.
A breakdown in US-Iran contacts or new attacks on Gulf shipping that lift oil again.
A cautious tone from Governor Bailey when he speaks on Thursday at 12:00 Dubai.
higher: US inflation or jobs figures below forecast, which would push expected Fed rises further out.
Progress in the talks Qatar is brokering, or further recovery in Gulf oil exports, bringing oil prices down.
Firmer signals that the Bank of England will raise rates in November.
watch: US core inflation (PCE) at 16:30 Dubai today, Governor Bailey on Thursday at 12:00 Dubai, then Friday's US jobs report at 16:30 Dubai.
